definition: a university teacher who gives talks
description: An old university lecture hall seen from the back rows, lit by a tall window. A young woman lecturer with her hair in a bun, in a green dress and dark cardigan, stands at a long wooden demonstration bench with a sink and a wooden pointer and looks at a student who raises her hand. She then walks to the tall sliding blackboards covered in chalk and points at them. Rows of students with long hair sit at curved wooden desks taking notes in open notebooks, and a clock hangs above the door.

taps.phrase: to stand at the demonstration bench
